subtitle: Sign in and pick up where you left off.

validation.identifierRequired: Enter your username or e-mail address.

forgotDialog.title: Forgot your password?
forgotDialog.body: Accounts are created by the school and passwords are reset by your school administrator. Contact your school’s system administrator for a new password.
forgotDialog.note: For your safety, never share your password.

noAccount: No account? Contact your school administrator.

help.title: Sign-in help
help.item1: Sign in with the username (or e-mail address) and password your school gave you.
help.item2: Use “Remember me” only on your own device.
help.item3: If you cannot sign in, contact your school’s system administrator.

hero.label: PUSULA welcome illustration
hero.title: One more step to your future.
hero.lead: Learn, explore, draw your own path.

demo.title: Demo access
demo.intro: This build is not connected to a server. Pick a role to explore the dashboard with sample data.

sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
firstLoginNote: You will be asked to set a new password the first time you sign in.

privacy.title: Privacy and personal data
privacy.body: Your personal data in PUSULA is processed under your school’s responsibility to provide its educational services. Only people whose role requires it (your teachers and the school administration) can access it.
privacy.contact: For which data is processed and your rights under the Turkish data protection law (KVKK), see your school’s privacy notice or contact the school administration.
